*   **Average Inventory:** $\frac{\$1,559.3\text{ million} + \$1,642.2\text{ million}}{2} = \$1,600.75\text{ million}$

### Step 4: Calculate Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC)

*   **CCC Calculation:** $52.60 + 36.40 - 92.70 = \mathbf{-3.70\text{ days}}$ *(using unrounded values: $52.597 + 36.401 - 92.699 = -3.70$)*
